content.test_md_blob:
# Inspect placeholder text and stable dimensions on direct focus

> Prove the centered header search field shows the promised placeholder, gains the promised focus affordances, and keeps its 420px by 36px footprint when focused.

## Step 1

Open {{start_url}} in a desktop browser and wait until the terminal header is visible with the centered global search field present.

## Step 2

Inspect the global search field in the header and assert its placeholder text is exactly "Search assets, metrics, reports..."; store its visible width as prefocus_width and height as prefocus_height.

## Step 3

Focus the global search field directly from the header.

## Step 4

Assert a visible focus ring is shown around the focused global search field.

## Step 5

Assert the focused global search field measures 420px wide and 36px high, and confirm those dimensions match prefocus_width and prefocus_height.

## Step 6 — assert @verifies ac-164, ac-161, ac-162, ac-163

Confirm absolute check: Search assets, metrics, reports... (equals) — the stated promise: The global search field placeholder is "Search assets, metrics, reports...".
